paragraphs.en: Welcome to our clubs! Can you play the guitar?
paragraphs.cn: 欢迎来到我们的俱乐部！你会弹吉他吗？

paragraphs.en: Yes, I can. I can also play the piano. Music is my favorite.
paragraphs.cn: 是的，我会。我还会弹钢琴。音乐是我的最爱。

paragraphs.en: Can you swim? No, I can't. But I can play basketball very well.
paragraphs.cn: 你会游泳吗？不，我不会。但我篮球打得很好。

paragraphs.en: What club do you want to join? I want to join the art club.
paragraphs.cn: 你想加入什么俱乐部？我想加入美术俱乐部。

paragraphs.en: I like drawing pictures. It makes me happy and relaxed.
paragraphs.cn: 我喜欢画画。它让我感到快乐和放松。

paragraphs.en: Come and join us! We have many interesting activities.
paragraphs.cn: 快来加入我们吧！我们有很多有趣的活动。
